title: Gradient Fill vs Gradient Border on a Button
description: 同一顆深色按鈕的四種寫法：漸層描邊要用雙 background + background-clip 分層；半透明實色描邊要留 background-clip: padding-box；以及漸層終點寫 130% 時底色到不了終點色。描邊預設放大加亮方便比較，可切回設計稿的原始數值。
descriptionEn: Four ways to style the same dark button: a gradient border needs two layered backgrounds with background-clip; a translucent solid border needs background-clip: padding-box; and a gradient ending at 130% never reaches its end colour. The border is exaggerated by default for comparison; switch back to the original design values.
author: Antonio
